title: A same-tree replacing PR (`Replaces #3381`) is the same act as the owner's "a" on PR 3381
ruling: Consultant's pick, not owner-typed, undoable, under the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words (consultant answer 07:07 CST Nov 15, relayed by the coordinator). The owner's "a" (01:43 CST Nov 15, item 865, ruling own-3381-a) granted landing PR 3381's change as is. A new PR number with the identical tree and nothing wider lands exactly that change, so it is the same act. Why it came up: `merge --review-record` refuses to post the fresh Sonnet round 1 PASS on #3381 (it restarts the review: fewer rounds than record 6890835699, no fix verifier); the tool's remedy is a replacing PR with the line `Replaces #3381`. Order: the lane opens the draft PR with `Replaces #3381` and posts the round 1 PASS there; runner 10 lints, merges it and closes #3381 as replaced. COVERED: only a PR whose tree is identical to #3381 at head cdb68f8d8d6a, with `Replaces #3381` and no product, test or file change (PR 3501, head cdb68f8d8d6a, read by triage 07:06 CST, is that PR). NOT COVERED: a different tree, a wider change, any other PR. A grant covers the named act, never a variant. Reopen if the owner says otherwise. Do not edit own-3381-a.
